tasks.title: WP-M6-01 gap-sec authn: JWT/JWKS, introspection, API keys, mTLS, PRM, token exchange client. Deliverables: JWT validation (alg allow-list, iss/aud/exp/nbf, JWKS cache+rotation), opaque-token introspection, Argon2id API keys, mTLS/SPIFFE principal mapping, RFC 9728 metadata endpoint, RFC 8693 exchange client; Principal with delegation chain; module stubs for authz/, vault/, egress/, sandbox/, audit/, quota/ in lib.rs; tests: token confusion, alg=none, wrong audience, expired/nbf, JWKS rotation, constant-shape failures, tenant derivation ignores body/headers (SEC-010).
